_comment: Expansion 3 part F.6: Polymorph and True Polymorph (the effects op 'shape': Battle.shape, rules/shapes.py). The forms are the creatures the game has; the game picks the strongest for a friend, the weakest for a foe.

polymorph.name: Polymorph
polymorph.text: A creature within 60 feet becomes a beast no stronger than itself while you concentrate: a friend the strongest it may be, a foe (on a failed Wisdom save) the weakest. Its hit points stay; the beast's come as temporary ones, and the shape ends when they are gone. No spells in it.

true_polymorph.name: True Polymorph
true_polymorph.text: A creature within 30 feet becomes any creature no stronger than itself while you concentrate: a friend the strongest it may be, a foe (on a failed Wisdom save) the weakest. Its hit points stay; the form's come as temporary ones, and the shape ends when they are gone. No spells in it.
